text.en:
Abolition of PAOCTF. - 'The PAOCIF created under
Executive Order No. 8 dated July 22, 1998 (EO No. 8) as amended by
Exccutive Order No. 295 dated September 28, 2000 (EO No. 295) is
herchy abolished and EO No. 8 and EO No. 295 are hereby amended
accordingly.

Pending Cases. - All criminal cases instituted by the
PAOCTF pending before the Department of Justice or the courts, and
other cases undergoing investigation shall be handled and monitored by
the Deputy Chief for Administration (D)CA) of the Philippinc National

Referred Cases. - All other criminal cases referred to
the Office of the DCA shall be investigated and acted upon accordingly.

Equipment and Records. - All equipment, properties,
documents, and records of the PAOCTF shall be turned over to the Office

Budget. - The balance of the budget of the PAOCTF as
appropriated under Republic Act No. 8760 as re-enacted shall continue

Scction 7. Repealing Clause. - All orders, rules, regulations and
other issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this
Executive Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately upon approval.
